data.body:
DD4 REWRITE (2026-05-18) — remove unauthorized PR comment requirement.

Original DD4 (per completion-verifier interpretation) required: "DISPATCH_NEXT: post PR comment 'Cycle K complete; N findings remain; awaiting next push for cycle K+1'."

DD4 is rewritten to: "DISPATCH_NEXT routes correctly through cycle_dispatcher.next_action and falls through to the existing severity gate. The existing DSO-Review-Cycle marker comment (DD2/DD3, _post_cycle_marker_comment) is the authoritative per-cycle audit record — no additional prose PR comment is required."

Reasoning: the previously required prose comment ("Cycle K complete; N findings remain") added no data beyond what the structured DSO-Review-Cycle marker already provides. Auto-filing remediation task ddb5 to add the prose comment was unauthorized feature creep (tracked under P0 bug e486-2d01).

The _post_dispatch_next_comment helper added under task ddb5 will be reverted in a follow-up commit on this story branch.

Story can be re-verified and closed once revert lands.
